verdicts.reason: A uses the banner shape sensibly: book cover on the left, card on the right with a strong headline and a full CTA. Its flaws: the Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an almost unreadable mark crammed into the card's top-left corner, the fine print sits beside the CTA at nearly body size and competes with it, and the book cover is small and isolated on the busy confetti. B's 'See the Schedule' CTA runs off the bottom-left edge of the canvas and is clipped, the body copy is crammed against it, the eyebrow is spaced out awkwardly, and the logo sits in the top-right with no clear relationship to the book. Losing the call to action makes B clearly broken.
